journal_entries_title_length.name: journal_entries_title_length
journal_entries_title_length.value: "journal_entries"."title" IS NULL OR char_length("journal_entries"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

chk_rel_source_one.name: chk_rel_source_one
chk_rel_source_one.value:
(
        ("relations"."source_article_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("relations"."source_character_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("relations"."source_pin_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("relations"."source_universe_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

chk_rel_target_one.name: chk_rel_target_one
chk_rel_target_one.value:
(
        ("relations"."target_article_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("relations"."target_character_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("relations"."target_pin_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("relations"."target_universe_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

chk_rel_manual_label.name: chk_rel_manual_label
chk_rel_manual_label.value: "relations"."origin" <> 'manual' OR ("relations"."label" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("relations"."label") BETWEEN 1 AND 60)

spike_chat_dice_shape.name: spike_chat_dice_shape
spike_chat_dice_shape.value:
(
        ("spike_chat_messages"."dice_expression" IS NULL AND "spike_chat_messages"."dice_values" IS NULL AND "spike_chat_messages"."dice_sum" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("spike_chat_messages"."dice_expression" IS NOT NULL AND "spike_chat_messages"."dice_values" IS NOT NULL AND "spike_chat_messages"."dice_sum" IS NOT NULL)
      )
